title: Peninsula Hot Springs – Bathe-in Cinema (Thursdays)
summary: Watch a film from the amphitheatre thermal pool every Thursday night through autumn and winter. Bathing ticket required, lineup posted weekly.
priceRange: Bathing session ticket required (see PHS website)
accessibilityNotes: Accessible thermal pools available; check specific needs with venue
weatherDependency: Outdoor amphitheatre – wet weather may affect screenings
nearbyAttractions: Arthurs Seat Eagle; Rye foreshore; local restaurants
suggestedItineraryPairing: Evening hot springs session followed by dinner in Rye or Dromana
editorVerdict: A film from a thermal pool in winter is one of those Peninsula things you do once and tell everyone about.
editorNote:
Thursday-night outdoor cinema at the Peninsula Hot Springs amphitheatre pool, running through autumn and winter. You bathe in the thermal pool while the film plays on the amphitheatre wall.

Who it's for: couples, friend groups, anyone after a date-night that's better than dinner-and-a-movie. The lineup is posted weekly on the PHS events page, so check the title before you book.

The practical move: bathing ticket is required and the amphitheatre pool fills fast, book early in the week. Warm robe waiting on the deck is the difference between magic and miserable. Dinner in Rye or Dromana on the way home.
